description: Defines a template class 'slotted_vector' for managing containers with optional elements, providing O(1) access, insertion, removal, and iteration that skips absent elements. Also defines 'slotted_id_vector' for ID-based indexing.

classes.name: slotted_vector
classes.description: A container managing optional elements with index-based access, stable indices, and efficient add/remove operations.

classes.name: slotted_id_vector
classes.description: A slotted_vector indexed via an ID type, supporting insert, emplace, erase, and ID-based access.

classes.name: slotted_vector_iter_impl
classes.description: Iterator implementation for slotted_vector that skips absent elements.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an index is present.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Inserts or overwrites element at index.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts element if index not present.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes element by index or iterator.
